subject: general
question: The Indian Parliament had passed the State Banks (Repeal and Amendment) Bill, 2017 to merge _______ subsidiary banks with the State Bank of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**five.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The State Banks (Repeal and Amendment) Bill, 2017 seeks to repeal the State Bank of India (Subsidiary Banks) Act, 1959, the State Bank of Hyderabad Act, 1956.
 
• These Acts merged the following subsidiary banks of SBI-
 
 
• State Bank of Bikaner
 
• State Bank of Mysore
 
• State Bank of Patiala
 
• State Bank of Travancore
 
• State Bank of Hyderabad
 
 
 
• Source- https://prsindia.org/billtrack/the-state-banks-repeal-and-amendment-bill-2017
